title: Vault 112 Simulation Data Egress and Memory-State Exfiltration Forensics
scope: Isolate and formalize the confirmed event in which memory/simulation-related state from Vault 112 physically leaves the experiment boundary on a stolen memory chip and later becomes causally active in the identity of A3-21/Harkness. This artifact intentionally distinguishes data egress from a software crash and keeps the source owner of the stolen memory state unresolved.

core_definition.simulation_data_egress: Data used or stored by the Vault 112 memory/simulation system leaves the original system boundary on a physical carrier.
core_definition.memory_state_exfiltration: A memory-state artifact is removed by an external actor without a demonstrated subject-controlled provenance or consent channel.
core_definition.cross_boundary_identity_state_leak: The exfiltrated state is later admitted into another entity and changes that entity's perceived biography and identity.
core_definition.causal_propagation: The imported identity state produces downstream behavior and social consequences outside Vault 112.

confirmed_sequence: Pinkerton penetrates Vault 112 while Braun is absorbed in the simulation.
Pinkerton steals a memory chip from Braun/Vault 112.
The chip physically leaves the Vault 112 authority boundary.
Pinkerton states that he does not know whose memories are stored on the chip before integration.
The memory technology is later used in the A3-21 identity-rewrite procedure.
A3-21 accepts a constructed Harkness biography as his own lived history.
The Harkness identity becomes socially consequential outside Vault 112.

causal_chain.compressed: VAULT112_MEMORY_STATE -> PHYSICAL_CHIP -> EXFILTRATION -> A3-21_IMPORT -> HARKNESS_IDENTITY -> EXTERNAL_SOCIAL_HISTORY

steps.name: INTERNAL_STATE
steps.description: Memory/identity-related state exists inside the Vault 112 system.

steps.name: PHYSICALIZATION
steps.description: That state is represented on a portable physical memory chip.

steps.name: EGRESS
steps.description: Pinkerton removes the chip from Vault 112.

steps.name: EXTERNAL_IMPORT
steps.description: The stolen memory state is introduced into A3-21 through Pinkerton's neural/memory procedure.

steps.name: IDENTITY_EFFECT
steps.description: A3-21 perceives the Harkness biography as his own past.

steps.name: SOCIAL_PROPAGATION
steps.description: Harkness acts in the external world under that identity, creating real relationships, duties and later identity-recovery consequences.

system_result.why: The experiment can continue operating while internal memory-state has already crossed the physical trust boundary.
system_result.security_interpretation: Runtime stability is insufficient evidence of containment. Export/egress boundaries are independently security-critical.

identity_consequence.result: Imported memory changes the causal story the subject uses to explain the present without replacing the underlying entity.
identity_consequence.secondary_effect: Once the new biography is accepted as past truth, it becomes a cause of new external behavior and relationships.

dithers_boundary.rule: Do not merge Dithers' local coherence anomaly with the confirmed Pinkerton data-egress event unless asset-level evidence binds them.

janus_genesis_lesson.risk_model: A portable state object can become more dangerous than a runtime fault if it crosses boundaries detached from provenance and is later admitted as authoritative identity truth.
requirements: exported memory/state must preserve source artifact identity
source and destination identity bindings must be explicit
export/import authorization or consent policy must remain attached where required
state must carry lineage across transport rather than becoming an anonymous blob
imported state must not silently overwrite authoritative Chronicle history
conflicts must become visible branches, rejected imports or unresolved states
external model-proposed memories remain non-authoritative until runtime admission

ru: Под вылетом симуляции здесь понимается выход данных симуляции за физическую границу Vault 112, а не падение программы Tranquility Lane.
Украденный memory chip превращает Vault 112 из закрытого эксперимента в информационно незамкнутую систему.
Внутреннее memory/identity state покидает убежище, внедряется во внешнего носителя и становится причиной личности Harkness.
Память может изменить воспринимаемую идентичность и последующую причинную историю, не заменяя сам underlying entity.
Связь украденного чипа именно с T. Dithers остаётся нерешённой.
Для Janus Genesis ключевой урок: provenance должен путешествовать вместе с памятью, иначе перенос состояния становится переносом неподтверждённой причинной истины.
en: Here, simulation escape means simulation data leaving the physical Vault 112 boundary, not a Tranquility Lane software crash.
The stolen memory chip turns Vault 112 from a closed experiment into an informationally non-closed system.
Internal memory/identity state leaves the Vault, is imported into an external host, and becomes a cause of the Harkness identity.
Memory can rewrite perceived identity and downstream causal history without replacing the underlying entity.
No shipped evidence currently binds the stolen chip specifically to T. Dithers.
For Janus Genesis, the key lesson is that provenance must travel with memory or transported state can become unverified causal truth.
